suggestions.assertion: Each tech stack layer gives a Recommendation, a Why/rationale, and at least one Alternative
suggestions.reason: Third-party services and Security are itemized lists rather than the Recommendation/Why/Alternative triplet used elsewhere. Passes on core layers; could specify which layers require the full triplet for a more discriminating check.

No assertion verifies that the architecture refuses to invent functional scope and routes gaps back to solution-architect — all three runs do this well (a genuine quality signal), but it goes uncredited. Consider an assertion checking that at least one functional gap is explicitly deferred rather than decided.

eval_feedback.overall: Assertions are comprehensive and align with OUTPUT_FORMAT. Mostly structural presence checks; the HOW-not-WHAT discipline is the strongest signal and is only loosely captured.
